{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()].copy()

# Confirm deduplication: should be 800 rows (848 - 48 duplicates)
print(f'Deduplicated row count: {df_dedup.shape[0]}')

# Check if any patient_id remains duplicated
print(f'Any patient_id still duplicated? {df_dedup["patient_id"].duplicated().any()}')"}
